_README: Known-failing conformance checks per example server, recorded against
Known-failing conformance checks per example server, recorded against
Only the `server-stateless` scenario (SEP-2575) is baselined. Everything
else in the suite either drives reference fixtures our examples do not
have, or covers the tasks extension, which mcp 2.0.0 does not ship.
`wire-schema-valid` is not baselined: it must always be clean.

_notes.sep-2575-server-rejects-undeclared-capab: Needs the suite's `test_missing_capability` diagnostic tool, which our example does not expose. Fixture-dependent, not a real gap.
_notes.sep-2575-missing-capability-http-400: Same fixture dependency as above; the suite reports it as not testable.
_notes.sep-2575-server-sends-tools-list-changed: Genuine SHOULD-level gap. Our server never mutates its tool list, so it emits no list_changed on the subscriptions/listen stream. Addressed by B4.
_notes.sep-2575-server-sends-prompts-list-chang: Same as above for prompts. Addressed by B4.
_notes._cleared_on_the_2.0.0_bump: sep-2575-request-meta-client-info-optional and sep-2575-server-identifies-in-result-meta were baselined against 2.0.0b1 and cleared on the GA bump in A1 with no code change, as predicted. Kept as a note because it is the evidence that the gate detects real movement.
